verdict.rationale: Alloy documents a per-request Sandbox mode, but it is described only as a way to "test your integration" without vendor charges. The pack contains no evidence of testing draft or proposed detection rules or workflows before activation, and no backtesting against historical events. Real-time and scheduled transaction-monitoring workflows describe live operation, not pre-activation rule testing, so Sandbox mode is an adjacent integration-testing feature rather than the story's capability.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can test proposed detection rules against historical or sandbox events before activation
